housing.text: Secured federal funding for affordable-housing acquisition and converting a hotel into housing for people experiencing homelessness.
housing.quote: $250,000 for the City of Redondo Beach’s Affordable Housing Acquisition to Lease Project

schools.text: Secured $2 million in federal funding for the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District’s Miraleste Intermediate School modernization project.
schools.quote: $2,000,000 for the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District’s Miraleste Intermediate School Modernization Project

safety.text: Secured federal funding for local crime-center and public-safety infrastructure projects.
safety.quote: $1,031,000 for the City of Hermosa Beach’s Real Time Crime Center Project

immigration.text: Lieu has opposed aggressive immigration enforcement, calling for a halt to ICE and CBP interior operations.
immigration.quote: an immediate nationwide stand down of ICE and CBP interior operations

guns.text: Lieu backs an assault weapons ban and universal background checks and has repeatedly pushed for stricter gun laws.
guns.quote: Democrats have introduced a number of commonsense gun safety reforms, including an assault weapons ban, universal background checks, a ban on pistol braces, and more.

abortion.text: Lieu, a Pro-Choice Caucus member, says he has worked throughout his career to protect access to abortion and reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: I have spent my career in public office working to protect equal access to reproductive health care for all Americans.

cannabis.text: Lieu voted for federal cannabis reform and says enforcement resources should not be spent on cannabis laws.
cannabis.quote: It is my longstanding belief that law enforcement resources and taxpayer money should not be used to enforce ill-advised cannabis laws.

health.text: Lieu defends the Affordable Care Act and expanded coverage, saying access to care should not depend on cost.
health.quote: The decision to seek care and take life-saving measures shouldn't come down to cost.

energy.text: Lieu, who authored California's AB 32 and introduced the Climate Solutions Act, calls for strong renewable standards and cutting carbon pollution.
energy.quote: set strong renewable energy standards and slash the carbon pollution that is damaging our planet.

voting.text: Lieu cosponsored voting rights legislation and says protecting ballot access should be a priority for every official.
voting.quote: Protecting the right to vote is foundational to our country's values and should be a priority for every elected official.

tax.text: Supports tax breaks for people buying homes or starting companies.
tax.quote: tax breaks for buying homes or starting companies

housing.text: Supports extensive housing construction and reducing regulations that restrict new development.
housing.quote: abundance through innovation zones and extensive building can change that. You can't purchase a home because regulations restrict new development

immigration.text: Supports secure borders, strong vetting, and enforcement to remove criminals, while opposing secret amnesty and people skipping the legal immigration process.
immigration.quote: Strong vetting will prevent and strong enforcement will remove criminals who threaten our families, ensuring secure borders to keep Americans safe.

health.text: Supports portable health savings accounts, cross-state competition, and allowing people to choose among healthcare providers.
health.quote: I support portable health savings accounts, cross-state competition, and a system that works for you to choose the best care for your family
